title: Laptop dock push into a glowing toolbar tour
summary: A lit laptop pushes in on one hopping dock tile and match-cuts to the mark; a glowing pill toolbar, word-by-word claims on black and drag-to-select grabs that drop into an editor canvas sell a screen-grab tool.
use_when: A screen or screen-grab tool whose UI is a small floating toolbar
A desktop utility launched from a dock or menu bar
Showing grabs becoming editable layers in a second app
Silent social cut where short black statements carry the pitch

look.type_style: bold geometric grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking, ~8 % H statements centred; small bold URL ~4 % H

sfx.event: dock tile hop settles / mark lands
cursor selects a mode or releases a drag
word enters with RGB split or glyph scramble

structure.shot: dark laptop lit by a blue streaked wallpaper; a frosted dock row of five app tiles, the product tile in the middle
structure.camera: push-in with speed-ramp: ~11 %/s for 0-3 s, ~38 %/s for 3-4 s (scale ~1.00->1.39->1.9, ±0.25 s), slight rotate -2.5 deg/s
structure.motion: middle tile hops up ~1 tile height at 1.77, holds, settles back by 2.77 (springs.snappy, overshoot not measurable); push accelerates on easings.inExpo into the tile

structure.shot: the product mark full-frame on deep navy, then small and centred on black
structure.camera: pull-out from mark filling the frame to ~12 % H, -36 %/s
structure.motion: springs.cameraOut ~8 fr (±0.25 s) from the match-cut; navy radial glow fades to black by 4.50

structure.shot: product name in bold grotesk writes in left to right while the mark is pushed right and clipped out
structure.motion: letters revealed left to right ~12 chars in 15 fr (±0.25 s) with the mark riding the leading edge, mark slices out by 5.77; name re-centres by 6.00 (springs.ui), holds 9 fr

structure.motion: toolbar enters from right with blur, springs.ui ~10 fr (±0.25 s), settled at 7.00; cursor-path from below to mode 2 7.00-7.50, hover highlight on 7.27, selected state holds to 8.27

structure.motion: each statement built word by word, 1 word per 0.25-0.5 s, centred and re-centring as it grows (springs.ui); the 2nd word of the first line enters with an RGB split for ~4 fr (±0.25 s); holds 8-15 fr

structure.shot: one statement of 3 words that states the price (free, with a percentage)
structure.motion: words appear one per 0.25 s, last word enters with RGB split ~4 fr (±0.25 s), settles by 11.27

structure.shot: dark desktop project page screenshot over a blue gradient; cursor drags a blue selection rectangle over the page header
structure.camera: pan up 67 px/s at 11.5-12.0, then near static; push ~1.0->1.10 at 13.0-13.5
structure.motion: cursor-path to top-left corner 12.27, drag to 12.77 draws an accent rectangle (easings.outQuint ~15 fr), released 13.00, rectangle clears 13.27

structure.shot: heavily defocused close detail of the grabbed sidebar
structure.camera: drift right ~224 px/s at 13.5-14.0, then pull back -24 %/s

structure.motion: frame-in-frame: scene settles into the canvas by 15.00, playhead visible, holds

structure.motion: card springs.heavy ~10 fr (±0.25 s); cursor-path to top-right 16.27, drag rectangle to 16.50, release, cursor exits lower-left 16.77-17.00

structure.shot: defocused extreme close-up of the phone screen corner on grey
structure.motion: depth blur over the whole layer, slow drift

structure.shot: the phone layer sits inside the editor canvas with side panels and the timeline
structure.motion: frame-in-frame into the editor canvas, settled by 19.00, holds 15 fr

structure.motion: first 2 words, then the rest scrambles in with glyph glitch 20.77 and resolves by 21.00, holds 12 fr

params.brand: brand.json: accent drives the toolbar rim glow, wallpaper streaks and selection rectangles; bg near black
params.content.dockApps: 5 neutral app tiles, product tile in the middle (the one that hops)
params.content.name: product name written in after the mark
params.content.toolbar: close + 3 grab modes + input picker; which mode the cursor picks
params.content.statements: 4 short statements of 2-3 words, built word by word; the last one states the price
params.content.sources: 3 single words naming input sources, then a 4-word line about layers
params.content.screens: 2 screenshots to select from (one desktop page, one phone screen) and the editor shell they land in
params.content.library: optional grid of 12 cards for the closing pull-out
params.content.signoff: 3-word sign-off with a name that decodes from glyphs
params.content.url: product URL for the closing line

notes: Silent reference; sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Only 3 detected cuts (4.00 match-cut, 21.40, 23.00), but the long 4.00-21.40 shot contains undetected black-background cuts near 8.50, 11.47, 15.50, 17.47, 19.37 (near_misses in cuts.json); all rows split there. Opening push is a speed-ramp: ~11 %/s for 3 s then ~38 %/s into the product tile. Words with RGB split and a glyph decode on the sign-off are proposed terms (rgb-split-word, glyph-decode), not in the vocabulary. Rows 8.50-10.75 are 3 merged statement rows (21 -> 19 rows).
